messages.text: Mama said the porch rail is loose again. Please do not buy all new lumber before I price the brackets.
I still have some of Dad's screws and that level in the blue box. I can patch it Saturday before Caleb's practice.
Good. And keep the receipt this time. You have Maya's choir fee and Caleb's shoes in the same week.
Already wrote it in the kitchen notebook. Rail first, no extra trips, and I am leaving by 2:10 for him.
Dad you were already up when I came down. Did the alarm even go off yet?
No, I beat it by a while. Sat on the porch, did that slow-count breathing, then put on the choir playlist low.
Ok. Mom said not to keep opening the bank app before breakfast.
She caught me. I will leave it alone until we sit at the table tonight.
Are we still stopping at the outlet before youth choir? I need black flats for the concert.
Can you still come to the school thing Thursday? Ms. Reed moved my part to 6:40.
We can get your flats. I am leaving my work shirts on the rack until after the 15th.
I told you I would be there, so I am making the shift swap work. Bring the folder from Grandma's table too.
The old pictures? I thought that was extra.
Ok. Mama said dinner is spaghetti again if you grab sauce.
I have noodles at home. I will pick up sauce and collards, then come straight back.
It helps when folks know whose shoulders they came from. And when you stand up there, take your time so every person in that room knows they matter.
For my history slide, can I use Grandma Evelyn's story about the school bus not stopping on her road?
Yes, but ask her first. Tell it as something she lived through, not as a sad ending.
I was going to put the photo of her and Aunt Denise by the old church sign too.
Good. Add what she built after that too. I want you to show the hard part and the backbone.
The Duke Energy extension is confirmed for Friday. I can put my clinic deposit toward rent first.
Good. My store check should hit around $2,200 after deductions, then I will cover the car note and gas.
Leave Maya's choir money and Caleb's lunch account alone. I will move the grocery list around tonight.
I will bring the receipts home and we can mark the envelopes after dinner.
I put your closing shifts on the fridge. Wednesday and Friday both run late, so please do not wait until 10:30 to open that module.
I saw it. I can finish the quiz after Caleb's practice. Schedule says 39 hours this week.
Good. And no calling about empty shop spaces until tuition clears and the car repair is paid down.
I know. I am just keeping the counter sketch in the notebook. Nothing signed, nothing owed.
Coach said practice ends at 6:15. Can we get chips after?
Maybe a small bag. When I pull up, wait inside until you see the van. If anything with flashing lights happens on the road, hands still, voice low, let me talk first.
ok. Coach Lewis said two parents were yelling about the fouls again.
Then we let Coach Lewis and Mr. Ray from church handle that talk. If somebody is getting hurt, we get help fast. If it is just grown folks loud, we step back.
Dad did you see that dunk clip I sent? The one with the blue team
I saw it. Same page had a ribs video right under it so now I want the grill cleaned out.
Can we watch more after homework? Also coach said check the road by Main because cones were up.
Homework first. I saved the clip and I am checking the Angier traffic post before we leave.
You still staring at that same bill stack? Put the car repair paper on top and tell me the number again.
I was adding it three different ways. Marcus said I should leave it alone tonight, but I kept checking.
Marcus is right for once. Call me after Maya finishes choir, and text Luis that you swapped Saturday before you forget.
I can call around 9. Andre may stop by tomorrow, so I will ask him about that tire shop too.
Baby, that paper Denise left on my counter has the town meeting date circled. Is that the one about the school roof and the road by Junny's?
Yes ma'am. I want to hear what they say before work. Same packet has a flyer from a crew group asking retail folks to stop by after shift.
Listen first. If they talking plain about hours, safety, and people not getting pushed around, that is worth hearing.
That's my plan. I'm not signing anything just because somebody has a table, but I'll ask questions.
Do I have to wear the white blouse for rehearsal tonight or can I wear my school hoodie
White blouse. Ms. Laverne likes everybody lined up clean when they practice before Sunday.
Fine. Grandma said you used to stand in the front row and act shy.
I was never shy once the organ started. I just knew better than to miss my cue.
Mrs. Bell asked if anybody went to that courthouse candle thing last summer. I did not say your whole business lol
You can say we stood with church folks, prayed, and came home. No shouting match needed.
Somebody in class said the video going around proves everything is fake. I just stayed quiet.
Quiet is fine. Tonight after dinner we can talk through what you saw and what you know before anybody reposts it.
You were moving slow on the steps this morning. Did you put the cold pack back in the freezer?
Yes. I used it before work and packed the gray shoes instead of the old pair.
Good. Please drink water today too. Tuesday nights are not worth limping through the store.
I hear you. The newer pair felt better by the last two games.
I put the blue bottle by your keys. Please take that instead of grabbing a Pepsi at work.
Got it. I packed the smaller container too, so lunch won't be that giant plate from yesterday.
Good. Also write down the cuff numbers tonight. Dr. Harris only said to keep a steady record for now.
I will. No new bottle from the pharmacy for me, just Mom's pickup after work.
Baby, I found two old envelopes in my drawer if you still want them. One says groceries and one says gas.
Yes ma'am. I used mine down after that shop bill. Trying to put 60 back in gas and 140 in groceries after work.
Good. Write it down before it walks off. And check your account before you hand anybody that card.
I checked it this morning. If anything else hits over 400, I can cover it, but I would have to move something around.
Are we really staying at the same stop for next year? The bus form opened today.
That is the plan. I told the office we need the Angier route left alone if they approve the paperwork.
Good. I do not want to figure out a new morning ride.
Me neither. I have had enough address forms with that same place on them.
Mom said dinner is on the stove. Are you still outside?
In the driveway. One more track, Coltrane is halfway through.
Ok but Caleb is trying to eat all the rolls.
Walking in when this horn part finishes. Save me two.
Can you grab chicken and green beans on the way? Maya came in and went straight to that project folder.
I got it. I'll help her after we eat.
Caleb asked if you were mad yesterday because you barely talked. Let's keep the table easy tonight and put the phones in the bowl.
Fair. I'll loosen up. If practice clothes are dry, he can pick the movie after homework.
I checked Food Lion. Chicken thighs, corn, slaw mix, and water are cheaper there. If you pick up ribs too, make it one pack.
That works. I'll get hickory chunks and lighter fluid, but I'm skipping the big cheese tray.
Thank you. Your mother asked whether you still have Uncle Ray's long tongs for St. Mark's lot tomorrow.
In the shed with the folding table. I'll rinse both after work.
Maya's choir is still Thursday at 6:30. Did your new paper say you are closing that night?
It did, 1:00 to 9:30. Marlene said she might swap me back if Tasha can take the last register.
Please let me know before I ask Mrs. Bell about a ride. Also, your total looked like 38 again even with Saturday off.
I will text you after the morning huddle. They still have me on five days.
I put both sample ballots by the coffee maker. Yours still has all those circles and question marks on the town races.
Leave mine there. I want to check the school board answers again before I decide on that one.
You already know where you are landing for most of the bigger offices, right?
Mostly, but the local seats need more homework. The names all run together until you read what they have actually done.
Dad are you home before tipoff
I am leaving work in ten. Do your reading first and keep your shoes by the door for Monday.
Can I wear the blue shorts to practice
Yes, blue shorts are fine. Save me the couch spot if the first quarter starts before I get there.
Dad did you see the school page? They changed the choir dropoff to 5:45.
I saw it when I opened the app at lunch. I put 5:35 in my phone so I leave work on time.
Also Ms Jenkins posted the permission form link, not the paper one.
Send it here too. I can fill it out after I check the bank and see what clears Monday.
I put Maya's permission slip and Caleb's practice card by your keys. Can you cover both pickups if my front desk runs late?
Yes. Caleb at 6:15, Maya at 7:00. I'll start rice before I leave so all four plates are easy.
Thank you. Please remind Caleb to bring the blue hoodie back inside this time.
Already on my list. Maya asked for quiet after choir too, so I'll keep the ride simple.
I put your W-2 and the pharmacy receipts in the blue folder. The school site still shows Friday for the next draft.
Good. I will run the numbers after Caleb eats and move the card payment before it hits late.
Denise asked if we needed her to float anything. I told her we were checking the folder first.
Tell her thank you, but no. I want to keep family out of it unless something breaks for real.
Are you still doing your computer work after dinner?
Yep, one chapter and a short quiz. I can watch the second half with you when I submit it.
Can I sit at the table too? I got math sheets.
Bring them. We both owe the table some quiet time tonight.
Son, when you come by after church can you look at that cabinet door? It keeps catching.
Yes ma'am. I can bring the little screwdriver set and tighten it before we eat.
I made greens, but don't let Caleb eat all the cornbread. Also I need a few things from the store.
Text me the list. I'll stop at Food Lion and be there around 12:30.
Dad that one you moved to the end today was better there
Sister Janice said the same. The room needed to settle before we brought that one in.
Mr. Leon was still lost on the low part though lol
I am going to catch him Thursday and walk him through it slow.
Are you still at work? I need the choir folder printed before 7.
Leaving in a few. Had to stay with Nia on the self-check screen and count down my drawer twice.
You always get stuck helping everybody lol. Mom said ask about that higher spot before you forget.
I asked. Carla said keep logging who I show the screens to and come ready for the closing checklist questions.
School account posted that club photos moved to Friday. Can you tell Mom?
I saw it when I checked the bus notice. I also saw the church youth choir reminder for Thursday.
Ok. Stop sending me old songs in my DMs though.
That bass line was too good. I saved it with the Impala quarter-panel repair video.
I put the Duke Energy extension confirmation in the blue folder. It moved the 118.46 to the 20th.
Thank you. My phone already buzzed me to update the notebook, so I changed that line and checked SECU.
Good. If the school fee clears tomorrow, use the small card for groceries and do not touch the 400 unless we have to.
That's what I wrote. If March stays between 3700 and 3900, April will breathe better.
If y'all do Asheville can I bring my blue hoodie? It gets cold in the car.
Dad, choir ends at 6:20. Can I walk over to the gym after?
Yes, if the numbers still work. We may just do Saturday morning out and Sunday back.
Wait by the side door with Aaliyah until I pull up. If Mr. Ken's truck is still by the gym, I may have him keep an eye while I finish at the grill table.
Mom said no fancy dinner there lol
Ok. They said the fish fry setup starts early, so people are already moving tables.
Correct. Sandwiches in the cooler, then maybe one small pour while y'all look in the shops.
Good. Stay where folks can see you. I will be there before the last pan comes off.
Denise said you need that paper from Raleigh. Is it at my house or in your brown folder?
Brown folder, I think. Wake County stamp on it, same one Mama kept with my school papers.
I remember. I put all that together when we were over here outside Angier.
I will grab it after work and then swing by your place before the office closes.
Are you coming to my practice or your grown up game?
Yours first. Mine is at the center at 8 if they still need one more.
Wear the shoes with the blue bottom. You said the other ones made you walk funny.
That is the plan. Help me remember my water bottle when we leave.
Can we play the Respect lady when you pick me up?
After my shift I need my first ten in the truck, then you can pick the song.
The loud one first please.
Deal. I already have that Aretha album in the door pocket.
Dad are you still coming to the gym? Coach said 7.
Yes. Finish spelling words before I get there.
Ok. Maya is at the table with her laptop and she told me don't touch anything.
Give her room. We'll eat when I get back, then no phones and maybe one quarter of the game.
Can we shoot after dinner or are you still quiet
Dad are we going to the hotel with the pool Saturday?
Not this Saturday, buddy. We are keeping it at home with baked chicken and the game.
We can shoot ten minutes. I just need to roll my shoulders and breathe first.
Can we still make cornbread?
Mom said leave the phone in the kitchen if you keep looking at that money app.
Yes. Cornbread and rice, and I will let you stir the batter after homework.
Fair. After we play, I am reading the tuition email once and then putting it away.
Did you and Tonya get the car place off your backs yet, or are you still staring at that paper?
Mama got another county envelope today. Is that yours or hers? She had both stacks on the table.
Did you ever look at that little vacant spot beside the laundromat, or did Tonya make you put the brakes on?
We paid half. After her reception check and my store check, the month is around $4,650 before we touch groceries.
Hers. Ours is just the old daycare stuff from when the kids were little. I keep it behind the W-2 sleeve.
I drove by on lunch. Too much rent right now. I wrote down foot traffic and left it there.
Then do not let those kids hear grown folks' numbers. Maya has school and Caleb has practice.
Good. And do not let that card bill make you too proud to ask me.
That is the first sensible thing you have texted me all week. Finish the class form, then talk fixtures.
They just know dinner is at home this week and movie night is from the DVD shelf.
I hear you. I moved a little from checking and left your name out of it.
That is the order. Form, promotion packet, then maybe a used cooler if the numbers still work.
Did you watch the county board clip I sent or did you fall asleep on the couch again?
Watched it on lunch. The one I usually would have skipped actually made sense on the ambulance staffing question.
See, that is why I told you not to just mark the familiar names.
I hear you. I still know my lane on most things, but these county offices hit the bills and the schools right here.
Did you write down what you wanted to ask at the meeting, or are you going to let them give everybody soft answers?
I wrote three lines: what happens after a bad stop, when families get to see the video, and whether the new training is checked by anybody outside the building.
Good. Also tell them folks should not have to wait until somebody is hurt before anyone listens.
That is on the page too. I am keeping it plain and calm.
Baby, I found that old folder from when you were at Harnett. Want me to save it?
Save it, please. Might help with the advisor call Monday.
I remember you taking all those extra hours back then. You did what you had to do.
I know. This time I am keeping the nights blocked off before I say yes to more hours.
You going over there tonight after work?
Yes ma'am. Janice wants me there by 6:30 so we can fix the second and fourth numbers before everybody comes in.
Don't fuss at them men too hard. Make them listen to each other.
That is the plan. If they lock in, Sunday will feel right.
Can you sign the choir trip paper tonight? Ms. Bell said money is due Friday.
Yes. Put it by the coffee can, not under your laptop. I moved grocery money around so we can handle it.
Also Mama said you still need to call about your cough before it drags on.
I called on break. Tuesday 8:40. I will take the early slot and still get Caleb after school.
Dad are you coming to practice today or mom
Mom today. Mr. Harris asked me to stay till 7 because two people called out.
Can you still see the game with me later
Yes, I should be home before the second half. Keep your shoes by the door for Mom.
Dad can I ask you later about what Jayden said at practice
Yes sir. We will talk after homework and before 2K.
He said his mom posted a thing and everybody was mad in the comments.
Do not answer them from your tablet. Bring it to me and we will sort out what is real.
Dad the boy at practice said my hair was funny again
I will talk with Coach after practice. Keep your head up and finish drills strong.
Can I still wear the headband Grandma gave me?
Yes. Wear it clean and proud. We don't answer foolishness by shrinking.
Mama said the counter called her again. Can you grab that little white bag today or do I need to handle it from Raleigh?
I can get it after my shift. Her place is on my way if I take 55 back.
Good. And please don't start fixing every loose thing you see over there.
No promises if that porch light is still flickering.
Son, if you go by Macedonia tomorrow, ask Deacon Harris if they still need pans for homecoming.
I can ask him after work. Tonya said she can do macaroni if they need another pan.
Tell him I still have your daddy's old hymn book too. It ought not sit in my closet.
I'll bring it Sunday. I remember holding that book before I could even read all the words.
Baby, did you see Sister Laverne's birthday supper changed to the fellowship hall?
Yes ma'am, it came up on my feed this morning with the new time. I saved it and set a buzz for Saturday.
Good. Your cousin put up those pictures from Caleb's game too.
I saw them. I'll show you after I pick up your refills and stop by.
Can I go shoot with Jayden after we eat?
Dad coach said I can start if I bring my form today
After you help me bag these leaves. Stay on our end of the street and tell Mrs. Powell if you cross by the mailbox.
I put it in your blue bag. I signed it after work like I said.
The red car at the empty house is still there.
Can you watch first half?
I saw it. You and Jayden keep the ball in his driveway until I finish these burgers.
Yes. And when Coach talks, look at him and say yes sir. How you carry yourself follows you farther than the score.
Mama said you skipped your own teeth appointment again. Was it the bill?
Yeah, I moved it out after the car repair. I am keeping the water with me and writing the cuff numbers until I can get back on the calendar.
Call the county office Monday before you decide. They may know a cheaper place, and the pharmacist at Food Lion is good about straight answers.
I will ask. Tonya said the same thing after checking with the front desk at work.
Tonya said you had another rough line this morning. You good?
I’m good. One man was mad about the sale tag, but I slowed it down, got the price checked, and kept the line moving.
That is the kind of example you need written down. Not just doing it, proving you can run the front when Carla steps away.
I wrote it with the safe drop time and the two returns I fixed after Malik typed the wrong code.
Are we taking that huge cooler to the youth choir thing?
Small one. Waters, oranges, corn, and the little foil pan.
good bc last time everybody was stuck by the fish line forever
That's how it goes when the old St. Mark's folks see each other. Second slab stays frozen today.
Can you sign the freshman trip form tonight? It says both home numbers need to match.
Bring it to the table after dinner. Tonya and I will check it before Caleb takes over the pencils.
Lol he already took my black pen. Also I need $12 by Friday.
I have it. Leave the form beside the mail basket so it doesn't get mixed with practice flyers.
I put the motel hold on the card but it cancels free until Friday at 6.
Good. If the tire money hits us, we can drop it and just ride to the park closer by.
Also I packed the little Advil bottle in the glove box. Your knee was stiff after inventory.
Thanks. I will keep it to water on the drive and save that coupon stop for after lunch.
I put the candidate sheet by the bills. The one you marked had notes all down the side.
I was comparing who mentioned pay scales, school buses, and the clinic line without acting like small stores can just absorb every fee.
Also, did that man from the breakroom table answer your question about payroll deductions and complaints?
Some. I told him if it's practical and keeps folks covered when management gets sloppy, I'll keep listening.
Denise called while I was at the desk. She said she can come down Saturday after her Raleigh appointment.
Good. I wanted her to look over Mama's forms before Janice asks for the final count.
Ask Andre about folding tables too. And please do not run the budget sheet again before dinner.
I closed it. Luis already covered the late shift, so Saturday is open after Caleb's practice.
Baby, I found your daddy's little notebook in the drawer with the flashlight batteries.
The one with oil changes and doctor numbers in the back? Please keep it on the counter. I want to copy some pages.
I will. Do not skip breakfast trying to do everybody's errands before work.
I packed oatmeal. After work I have Maya's form, Caleb's practice bag, and your refill in one loop.
Caleb's 6:30 at the rec still stands. Please do not forget his mouthguard this time.
Got it. I packed it with his socks and the orange bottle.
Good. Marcus texted about your 8 o'clock after, but only go if Caleb is done with homework.
That works. If he finishes early, we may catch the last few minutes at home before bed.
Dad coach said if we change houses I might be on another team
Nothing is changing right now. I turned in the packet so we can keep practice and school simple.
So still Angier gym on Tuesdays?
Yes. Same gym, same drive past Grandma's, same snack stop if homework is done.
Baby why are you texting me before the rooster. You been asleep?
Some. Bills kept turning in my head. I put on Rev. Harris singing and said my prayer instead of opening the app again.
Good. And if that card Tonya gave you needs calling, call it. The Lord made helpers too.
I hear you, Mama. I am giving this week a real try first.
I moved the New Bern confirmation email to the April folder. Please do not pay anything else on it today.
Thank you. I packed rice, beans, and leftover collards for lunch so I will not stop anywhere.
Good. Also your brown shoes can make it another week if you polish them tonight.
I will polish them after dinner. I already put chicken out to thaw.
Coach put the bracket picture up. We play at 10 not 11.
I got it. I added 9:20 to my phone so we can grab water first.
Can you get the shoes from that guy after work?
If he answers the listing. I checked my card balance and Friday pay hit, so we are okay if they fit.
Tonya said you sat out front a minute. Long day?
Just let Marvin finish before I came in. That record does better than me talking right away.
I know you. Eat first before you start solving everybody's problems.
Son, Sister Ruth's niece put up that supper plate collection for her surgery ride. Can you share it for church?
I can share that after work and ask folks to keep them lifted.
Good. And don't you put all your own bills out there. Call me or Denise if the table gets heavy.
I hear you. I am not posting our car repair mess. I will talk to family first.
Baby, I found that picture from the tobacco road picnic. Your granddaddy is standing by Mr. Hinton's truck.
Hold onto it for me. Maya and Caleb need to see faces with the stories, not just dates in a book.
I can tell them how folks helped each other when the mill would not hire everybody fair.
That's the part I want them to hear. Not just what was blocked, but how people kept feeding families.
Baby, Denise said there was a notice about Raleigh Road. Are you still coming by after work?
Yes ma'am. I saw that notice and will come around by 210. I may stop first if that man answers about the dresser.
Don't buy something heavy unless somebody can help you lift it.
I asked for measurements. Same group has a set of Chevy trim pieces too, but I am just looking.
Baby, do you need my red tub for Saturday?
Yes ma'am, and the old apron. I'm only doing a shoulder and some chicken this time.
Good. Put greens and fruit out first for those children. Your daddy used to sit by that barrel half the afternoon.
I can see him there. I'll bring your plate before we head over.
Dad the bus is late and Ms. Porter said we might get dropped by the corner instead of school.
Stay with Janelle and keep your phone charged. If the van gets waved over when I come, remember: hands where they can be seen, no reaching in your bag, short respectful answers.
I know. You told me like 100 times.
I will keep telling you. For that corner issue, I am texting Ms. Porter first so the school handles it before it turns into a mess.
Are you picking me up after choir or are you stuck at work again?
I get off at 6. I will be there by 6:25, then I have two chapters to read after dinner.
You still doing that notebook with snacks and coffee prices?
Yes, but just numbers. If your friends keep buying those $4 iced drinks, somebody needs to study the math.
Dad can I get $8 for team snacks today?
Yes. I have it. Do not ask your sister or your mama while she is at the clinic desk.
Ok. Coach said bring cash before practice.
I will hand it to you after my shift. Eat the sandwich in the fridge first.
Mama said Rev. Carter asked if you can help set chairs before the Saturday program. You know she volunteered you.
That's Mama. I can be there at 8:30 if Caleb's practice doesn't run late.
Good. And do not act like you forgot how to clap on two and four just because you sell appliances now.
That was trained into me early. Daddy, Mama, ushers, choir aunties, all of them made sure.
Baby, Mr. Alston asked if you could help stack chairs after the men's breakfast. I told him you had Caleb later.
I can stay thirty minutes. I told Tonya I would be back by 10:15, so I am holding to that.
That's right. Help, then get on home. Folks remember a man who keeps his word.
Yes ma'am. If Mrs. Perry needs a ride after, I will ask Deacon Lewis so she is not waiting outside.
Dad are you still coming to practice after the store?
Yes. I may be 10 minutes late. The front lot has a table again and I want to ask one more question about schedule changes.
Coach said the gym floor is messed up too.
I know. That's why I wrote down the parks floor, the school crossing, and that stop-sign camera comment for Tuesday.
Y'all made it back from the mountains yet, or did Tonya find another outlet store?
Home now. We kept it simple: motel, waterfall, pizza slices, then I used that flight coupon.
Look at you spending exactly one coupon and calling it vacation.
That was enough. Two little glasses, then water because I had the wheel coming down I-40.
You looked lighter when y'all finished this morning.
That last one did something to me. Everybody came in together and I needed that.
I could tell. Just remember Caleb has practice at 4, so don't stay after too long next Sunday.
I won't. I just need to ask Janice about the first two for Thursday.
Did you ever call the shop back, or are you still staring at that receipt like it will apologize?
I called. Nothing else due right now. That 486 was what pushed February to 4200.
Then stop carrying it all in your head. Put the real number in your book and let Tonya see the bank screen with you.
I did. March is tracking at 3810 if nothing new pops up. Keeping the card clear in case a 400 thing lands before payday.
Did you send the transfer form or are you still staring at it like it owes you money?
Sent it. They said two old credits may still count, so I am waiting on the review.
Good. And when the supervisor spot opens, you can say you have been doing the work and the paper trail.
That is the plan. Also told Maya and Caleb I am not skipping Thursday, even if inventory runs long.
Did you go by the library like you said? I still have that card on my table.
I went before opening shift last Thursday. I can take you Friday after I pick up your prescription.
I want you to tell me which school people you read about. I do not know those names.
I will bring my notes. The ones I liked for the bigger offices were easy, but the school ones took some reading.
Mama said you were hobbling after that gym night again. You hardheaded.
Not as bad this time. I wore the blue-bottom pair and sat out two runs.
Look at you making almost-sensible choices. Is this the same Tuesday crowd?
Mostly. Center had a makeup game, so I went after work.
Baby, I found some cash in my church purse if you need help with that bill.
No ma'am. Keep that for your groceries. The deposit came in, so I handled the light bill and put a piece away.
All right. Bring me that old county paper when you come Sunday so Denise and I do not mail the wrong thing.
I will. Mine is the old one from when Caleb was small. Yours is the only one that needs an envelope now.
Are you picking me up from club or should I ride with Janelle
Ride with Janelle today. The board changed again and I am on 12 to close.
Ok. Mom said your March paper still has almost 40 even after they moved days.
That sounds right. I am off Sunday, then back Monday morning.
I saw your three missed drafts about that school fee. Pick one amount and send it, David.
You know me too well. I was about to ask Marcus, Andre, and Luis the same question.
No committee tonight. Send Tonya the screenshot, then call me after Janice's choir rehearsal lets out if you still need to talk.
Sent it. I will call you around 8:30 after I pick Maya up.
I found those old church picnic pictures. You and Tonya looked so young in that first one.
Hold onto them. Maya wants to see the one before she was here, and Caleb will laugh at my shirt.
Bring all of them Sunday if their homework is done. I will make enough chicken for four plates to go.
We'll come after church if Tonya's shift doesn't run over. I can fix your porch light then too.
Dad are we going to Grandma Evelyn's before practice?
Quick stop. I have to put her trash bin back, tighten the gate latch, and drop off those apples.
Can I stay in the car with my game?
For a minute, then help me carry the bag. We'll still make practice by 5:30.
Dad they tied it
I saw. Finish your snack and keep your feet off the table.
Can you show me that move from Marcus night tomorrow
After chores. We can work on it in the driveway before we leave for your 11:00.
If that manager tries to bump the payment again, ask for the history. They have records back to 2019.
I asked. She said the file is thick enough that I should have my own drawer.
That sounds like you. Raleigh hospital, Angier schools, Angier ball games, Angier everything.
I know what roads work for us. If we ever shift, it is not going far.
I saw your share for Sister Ruth. That was fine. But somebody tagged you under that long mess about the courthouse again.
